title: Malicious code in @arks-labs/utils (npm)
description: The npm package @arks-labs/utils contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a separate, trusted machine. Removing the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
